title: Exclude two retimed chart-564 ingress replacements preserving the fixed first readers
body:
Changing 2751 and one named companion cannot recover the chart-564 first reads and output 150 within the frozen exterior, even with retimed nonlinear scalar payloads.

## Scope and source

Uses #7934, #7925 and 104 legal senders, grants their earlier local history and the z observation, and preserves the named first reader contracts. A separate optimistic fifth arrival already loses if every other charge stays fixed. The source comparator is #7830 at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-bit469-retimed-double-ingress/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. The offline replay checked 208 independent dual certificates, both diagnostic operators, the oracle contrast, bridge and price controls. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Change the exterior stock or reader contracts, or fund an additional arrival while preserving the full changed productive boundary.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
